# Is the platform covered, and are its workers presumed employees?

> Free EU Platform Work Directive (2024/2831) checker for gig and app platforms and platform workers: is the platform in scope, how strong is the employment presumption, which algorithmic-management rules apply, and how long until 2 December 2026. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
